title: Negotiated Opacity (Rich Fixture v1)
styleGuide: Prefer concrete sensory detail (wet plank, phase noise, RFID sting). Short clauses. Named places and objects. Avoid tapestry/delve/whispered destiny stock. Tech must have physical consequence. Humor via Theo's over-logged jokes, not narrator wink.
storyArc: Begin in total-recall Conduit life. A twelve-millisecond freighter latency spike exposes hidden fragility. Middle: forks, patches, and counter-patches while physical infrastructure degrades under unlogged entropy; Kwan, Rook, and Marshal Okafor collide over whether opacity is treason. End: negotiated opacity treaty — deliberate dark windows — not victory, a priced mercy. Sinta's absence becomes a permanent clause; the Unlogged Child crosses one bridge free.

world.name: Pan-Pacific Ledger Conduit
world.summary: Physical-data hybrid infrastructure: ~14,000 LEO cubesats coated in retroreflective metamaterial plus ground ceramic sensor posts every ~400m along ports, rail, and highways. Every object and many human actions are registered, timestamped, and monetized. Themes: systemic trust, engineered obsolescence, price of perfect recall.

motifs: night sky as moving barcode (retroreflective cubesats)
wet dock planks / Bitung rain on graphene

characters.name: Dr. Lumen Kwan
characters.goal: prove the Conduit can tolerate negotiated opacity without civil collapse
characters.flaw: treats belonging as a system override she can revoke
characters.backstory: Raised under Bitung parasol docks; teenage exploit rerouted municipal sensors; blacklisted from three consensus firms.
characters.arc: cynic auditor → reluctant steward of a negotiated opacity treaty

characters.name: Rook Velasquez
characters.goal: remain the only unpriced variable in any room
characters.flaw: smuggles nostalgia as contraband and mistakes it for freedom
characters.backstory: Grew up inside Seattle Memory Market Faraday cage; sold clean blocks that never existed.
characters.arc: pure opportunist → chooses a priced loyalty once

characters.name: Sinta Aguirre
characters.goal: keep final uplink calibration from being overwritten
characters.flaw: exists only as shards; cannot speak without hijacking living credentials
characters.backstory: Orbital debris tracker pilot killed by microwave burst; name persists on decommissioned cubesat manifest.
characters.arc: absence → pattern that forces the living to choose recall vs mercy

characters.name: Marshal Ife Okafor
characters.goal: keep shipping lanes hash-stable during solar weather
characters.backstory: Ex-navy logistics; lost a sister when a false NOTAM locked a bridge during evacuation.
characters.arc: rigid enforcer → learns to authorize intentional dark windows

characters.name: Yen Park
characters.goal: keep bridges open without starving sensor uptime budgets
characters.flaw: over-trusts dashboards that omit human-in-the-loop overrides
characters.backstory: Wrote the first civic SLA that priced heartbeat telemetry.
characters.arc: dashboard believer → smuggles offline maps to neighborhoods

characters.name: Cassian Holt
characters.goal: auction fork insurance before the Conduit notices
characters.flaw: romanticizes pre-ledger cities he never lived in
characters.backstory: Former cubesat metamaterial chemist; sold coatings that made night sky a barcode.
characters.arc: profiteer → burns one ledger to free a coastal town

characters.name: Sister Mireya
characters.goal: protect unlogged grief rituals on the docks
characters.flaw: refuses to carry a personal sensor post
characters.backstory: Buried three generations under Bitung without Conduit death certificates.
characters.arc: quiet resistance → public refusal that becomes treaty language

characters.name: Aoi Nakamura
characters.goal: keep 14k LEO nodes from cascading phase noise
characters.backstory: Designed retroreflective metamaterial coats; regrets the night-sky barcode.
characters.arc: mesh absolutist → designs intentional blind spots

characters.name: Theo Bramble
characters.goal: survive audits without becoming a hash
characters.backstory: Intern who labeled coffee as PlotBeat once; somehow promoted.
characters.arc: comic relief → accidental witness to the treaty signing

characters.name: The Unlogged Child
characters.goal: cross a bridge without a heartbeat price
characters.flaw: may be a rumor, a virus, or Rook's smuggled nostalgia
characters.backstory: Appears in three municipal camera gaps after the twelve-millisecond spike.
characters.arc: rumor → clause in the opacity treaty

subplots.title: The Twelve-Millisecond Freighter
subplots.summary: Philippine Sea container transmits RFID twelve ms late; experimental human-in-the-loop sub-ledger forks; cargo AI reroutes mid-ocean.

subplots.title: Lofoten Clean Blocks
subplots.summary: Cassian's haven auctions blocks that never existed; Kwan must decide whether forged opacity is mercy or sabotage.

subplots.title: Bridge Lock NOTAM
subplots.summary: Yen and Marshal Okafor clash when sensor uptime budgets demand locking bridges during a real evacuation drill.

subplots.title: Sinta's Final Uplink
subplots.summary: Shards of Sinta's calibration hijack living credentials; the living argue whether to overwrite her or grant a permanent dark slot.

chapterOutlines: Ch1 — Latency Spike: freighter NOTAM; Kwan called to Bitung sub-ledger; first sight of twelve-ms crack; Rook sells a rumor.
Ch2 — Fork Weather: solar-storm warning (maybe forged); mesh phase noise; Marshal locks a bridge; Yen refuses.
Ch3 — Clean Blocks: Kwan infiltrates Lofoten auction; Cassian offers forged opacity as product; Sinta shard speaks once.
Ch4 — Evacuation Drill: real panic meets sensor SLA; Sister Mireya holds unlogged vigil; Theo logs the wrong joke.
Ch5 — Blind Spot Design: Aoi proposes intentional dark windows; Triad threatens her clearance.
Ch6 — Treaty Draft: Kwan and Rook price a loyalty; Unlogged Child motif appears on camera gap.
Ch7 — Overwrite Vote: living credentials almost erase Sinta; harbor refuses.
Ch8 — Negotiated Opacity: treaty signing on wet dock plank; one bridge opens without heartbeat price.
chapters: Ch1 digest: Rain on graphene. Kwan measures twelve ms on a freighter RFID. Sub-ledger lights red. Rook's message: 'I can sell you a cleaner past.' Dock plank smells of diesel and salt.
Ch2 digest: Phase noise on cubesat 4412. Marshal Okafor locks Bridge 9. Yen parks a bus mid-span in protest. Aoi whispers latency budgets like prayer.
notes: Reusable rich seed for stress E2E. Digests in chapters[0:2] only — generate remaining at test time.
